scripts.dev:tauri: cd apps/desktop && npm exec -- tauri dev
scripts.build:tauri: cd apps/desktop && npm exec -- tauri build --debug --no-bundle --ci
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jarvis/backend && npm run build -w @jarvis/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/backend && npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/desktop
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json eslint.config.mjs apps/desktop/frontend services/backend/src services/backend/test services/backend/package.json services/backend/tsconfig.json domains/core/src core/protocol/package.json tests/contract
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json eslint.config.mjs apps/desktop/frontend services/backend/src services/backend/test services/backend/package.json services/backend/tsconfig.json domains/core/src core/protocol/package.json tests/contract
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jarvis/protocol && npm run test -w @jarvis/backend
